# Pesher Habakkuk Column 9 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Pesher Habakkuk Column 9 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 9:2 — "will not abide" vs. "will not endure" vs. "never rest"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "will-not abide" | Hebrew lo' yinveh |
| LOGOS | "will not endure" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "never rest" | Dynamic simplification |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "will not endure." Clearer modern English; PNEUMA's "never rest" loses the sense of impermanence.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 9:2-3 — "throat" vs. "gullet" vs. "mouths wide"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "his-throat" | Hebrew nafsho — here used physically |
| LOGOS | "his gullet" | More visceral term |
| PNEUMA | "their mouths wide" | Dynamic restructuring; changes to plural |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "his throat" (EMET). "Gullet" is accurate but rare; PNEUMA changes the number and body part.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 9:7-8 — "standing" vs. "office" vs. "came to power"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "his-standing" | Hebrew 'amado — literally "his standing up" |
| LOGOS | "his office" | Formal interpretation |
| PNEUMA | "he first came to power" | Dynamic paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "his office." Captures the political sense of the Wicked Priest's role better than the bare literal.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
*Total disagreements in Column 9: 3 | Covers Hab 2:5-6*
